articles.title: Holland America Line Unwraps A Season Of Holiday Dining, Entertainment And Festivities - Cruise Addicts
articles.summary: Holland America Line is launching its 2026 holiday season cruises, offering guests special voyages packed with festive traditions, seasonal flavors, and memorable celebrations at sea. These meticulously planned international cruises aim to provide unique onboard experiences, enabling travelers to savor holiday festivities in a distinctive and luxurious setting, catering to global clientele seeking a festive escape.
